title: Loops in one place, swipes that take back their hit
thisBuild: Tap the loop readout at the top: loops A to H are pad sized now, with Click, Count, and - + 2x for the loop you are in. Its bars, Copy to, Clear, Auto, Bottle it and the Song are all in there too.
Steps and Roll lost their own rows of loops and bars; a line at the top says which loop and bar you see, tap it for the strip. Song has no tab any more: it is in the strip.
Swipe the loop readout left or right for the previous or next loop.
Count-in: with Rec on, Play from a stop clicks a bar first (Count 1, 2 or off). The click is on out of the box.
A swipe off a pad takes back its own hit: it still sounds on touch, then fades the moment the swipe is clear, and a recorded hit comes out.
Swipe right opens the FX vials under that pad's row, two rows of wider vials.
Synth: one row of kinds, Simple/Full and Poly/Mono/Acid are one-tap switches, Synthipad is gone, and putting the scratch synth over a pad with a sound takes a second tap.
Tabs sit in one milled slot with your page raised (Settings, Look: Tabs: keys to go back). Readouts shrink to fit instead of cutting off. The help lines are gone.
watch: Swipe off a drum pad while recording: do you hear a blip before it cuts, and is that OK?
Record with Count 1: does the bar of clicks land right before the loop?
Is the loop strip too tall on your phone with Song open?
Do the two rows of vials under a row feel playable?
limits: The FX, wave and synth-kind icons are drawn for you to review first; they are not in the app yet.
The other cut and look ideas you didn't pick are not in this build.
The master filter on Perform and the Keys menus are unchanged.
